schema: CREATE TABLE achievements (user TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user, id))
CREATE TABLE campaign_nodes (user TEXT NOT NULL, campaign TEXT NOT NULL, node TEXT NOT NULL, done_at INTEGER NOT NULL, choice TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (user, campaign, node))
CREATE TABLE card_styles (user TEXT NOT NULL, card TEXT NOT NULL, item TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user, card))
CREATE TABLE cards (user TEXT NOT NULL, set_code TEXT NOT NULL, card_number TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, rarity TEXT NOT NULL, count INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user, set_code, card_number))
CREATE TABLE career_tables (table_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, data TEXT NOT NULL, created INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE challenge_results (user TEXT NOT NULL, week TEXT NOT NULL, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, won INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, best_turns INTEGER, best_life INTEGER, at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user, week))
CREATE TABLE daily (user TEXT NOT NULL, day TEXT NOT NULL, wins INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, games INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, person_games INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (user, day))
CREATE TABLE decks (user TEXT PRIMARY KEY, deck TEXT NOT NULL, updated INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE pair_games (day TEXT NOT NULL, pair TEXT NOT NULL, games INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (day, pair))
CREATE TABLE payout_events (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, at INTEGER NOT NULL, event TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, paid_by TEXT, paid_at INTEGER, before TEXT, after TEXT, checked TEXT)
CREATE TABLE payouts (match_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user TEXT NOT NULL, at INTEGER NOT NULL, opponent TEXT NOT NULL, won INTEGER NOT NULL, coins INTEGER NOT NULL, xp INTEGER NOT NULL, note TEXT)

CREATE TABLE profile (user TEXT PRIMARY KEY, created INTEGER NOT NULL, starter TEXT NOT NULL, coins INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, xp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, wins INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, losses INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, wc_common INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, wc_uncommon INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, wc_rare INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, wc_mythic INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pack_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, level_paid INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, quest_day TEXT, reroll_day TEXT, count_ai_games INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, show_progress INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, quest_week TEXT, capsule_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE progress_games (game_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user TEXT NOT NULL, at INTEGER NOT NULL, details TEXT, kind TEXT, won INTEGER, coins INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, xp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reason TEXT, revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE pulls (user TEXT NOT NULL, machine TEXT NOT NULL, item TEXT NOT NULL, at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user, item))
CREATE TABLE puzzle_results (user TEXT NOT NULL, puzzle TEXT NOT NULL, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, solved_at INTEGER, stars INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (user, puzzle))
CREATE TABLE quests (user TEXT NOT NULL, slot INTEGER NOT NULL, quest TEXT NOT NULL, progress INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, assigned TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user, slot))

CREATE TABLE runs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, started INTEGER NOT NULL, ended INTEGER, state TEXT NOT NULL, wins INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, losses INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, data TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE schema_version (version INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE set_unlocks (user TEXT NOT NULL, set_code TEXT NOT NULL, at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user, set_code))
CREATE TABLE stats (user TEXT NOT NULL, counter TEXT NOT NULL, value INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user, counter))
CREATE TABLE token_log (user TEXT NOT NULL, at INTEGER NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE unlocks (user TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, item TEXT NOT NULL, at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user, kind, item))
CREATE TABLE weekly (user TEXT NOT NULL, week TEXT NOT NULL, wins INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (user, week))
CREATE INDEX cards_by_name ON cards (user, name)
CREATE INDEX challenge_results_by_week ON challenge_results (week, won, best_turns)
CREATE INDEX payout_events_by_state ON payout_events (state, at)
CREATE INDEX payouts_by_user ON payouts (user, at)
CREATE INDEX progress_games_by_user ON progress_games (user, at)
CREATE INDEX runs_by_user ON runs (user, kind, state)
CREATE INDEX token_log_by_user ON token_log (user, at)

machines.name: Full Art
machines.blurb: Ten painted sets of five: whole-card art for staples, no frame and no text.
machines.blurbEs: Diez sets pintados de cinco: arte de carta completa para clásicos, sin marco ni texto.

sets.name: Ukiyo Tides
sets.style: Japanese woodblock print (ukiyo-e): flat areas of indigo, Prussian blue and pale cream, bold black key lines, wood-grain texture in the flat colour, stylised curling waves with claw-like foam, a muted coral accent used sparingly.

items.subject: a great curling wave rising to swallow a falling spark of light, the spark snuffed in its foam
a scholar in a small boat under a storm sky, three paper charms whirling up out of the sea around them
a lone figure on a rock at dusk looking down into a still tide pool that mirrors the moon
a robed sage standing on the crest of a towering wave, one open palm raised to halt the sea
a single long heron's beak spearing a glowing bubble on the water's surface, ripples spreading

sets.name: Neon Noir
sets.style: Rain-soaked synthwave noir: deep black-violet night, wet streets and glass reflecting hot magenta and electric cyan neon glow, hard rim light, film grain, cinematic and moody, neon light from bare glowing tubes, strips and lamps rather than signs.

items.subject: a gloved hand pulling one glowing card out of a silhouette's head in a neon-lit alley
a shadowy figure toppling backwards off a rain-slick rooftop ledge, neon city far below
an interrogation room lit by one cyan lamp, a hooded figure leaning over a table of scattered cards
two fingers pinching out a candle flame, the smoke curling into a magenta skull against the rain
a shattered chrome mannequin in a puddle, its limbs scattered and reflecting pink neon

sets.name: Cathedral Glass
sets.style: Gothic stained glass window: jewel-tone glass panes in gold, ruby, sapphire and white, thick dark lead lines between panes, light glowing through the glass, a pointed-arch tracery feel, saints and symbols shown as simple heraldic figures.

items.subject: a sword bending and turning into a plough blade in a field of golden wheat, sun rays behind
a sealed stone tomb under a white lily, a ring of candles and a closed gate around it
a hooded priest holding a glowing lantern before a barred door, a shadow pressing against it
a beam of white light splitting through a prism into five coloured rays that dissolve a dark shape
a pale elemental swordswoman with a blade of light, standing alone in a radiant halo

sets.name: Field Guide
sets.style: Vintage naturalist's field journal: delicate watercolour and fine ink linework on aged cream paper, specimen-plate composition, soft greens, ochres and browns, pressed leaves and small sketched details around the main specimen, no labels or handwriting.

items.subject: a slender elf druid crouched on a mossy root, a sprout of glowing green growing from their palm
an elf mystic in a cloak of leaves, eyes closed, fireflies circling a staff of living wood
a large banded forest spider in the middle of a dew-covered web strung between two branches
a scarab beetle with an iridescent shell walking over rippled sand, studied from above
a great crocodile half-submerged at a river ford, reeds and a stepping-stone path beside it

sets.name: Pulp Inferno
sets.style: 1950s pulp magazine cover painting: saturated reds, oranges and yellows against deep blue shadows, dramatic low angles, halftone dot texture, bold painterly highlights, explosive action, a retro adventure feel, no title block or lettering.

items.subject: a jagged red-gold lightning bolt striking down from a storm, a figure thrown back by the blast
a hero firing crackling lightning from both hands, the burst exploding into a star of sparks
a demon's clawed hand rising from a lava crack, waves of heat warping the air around it
a rocket-pack hero swooping down through flames to smash a clanking robot apart
a towering humanoid of living flame stomping through a burning town at night

sets.name: Clockwork Atelier
sets.style: Victorian clockwork technical illustration crossed with oil painting: polished brass, copper and walnut, intricate gears and springs, warm workshop lamplight, a faint blueprint grid in the background, precise and rich.

items.subject: a single heavy brass finger ring standing upright on a walnut workbench, a tiny glowing sun floating in its hole, warm light spilling over scattered gears
a signet ring with an engraved gear seal resting on a wax-sealed envelope, glowing faintly
a smooth polished stone mounted in a brass cradle of gears, a soft glow pulsing inside it
a glass flask in a brass cage, swirling with luminous thoughts like tiny drifting cogs
an armillary sphere of brass rings around a glowing orb, standing on a walnut workbench

sets.name: Paper Lands
sets.style: Layered paper-cut diorama: many stacked layers of cut coloured paper with soft drop shadows between layers giving depth, clean curved silhouettes, matte paper texture, a gentle backlight glowing through the deepest layer.

items.subject: a pale beach where white sand meets layered turquoise waves, a low sun behind cliffs
a rainforest valley in layers of mist, a river winding between tall green trees and waterfalls
a dark marshy river delta under a violet sky, dead trees and black water channels
a steaming mountain lake in a red volcanic crater, plumes of steam rising into the sky
rolling foothills covered in pine forest rising toward a smoking red mountain

sets.name: Pixel Inventory
sets.style: True low-resolution pixel art, like a 16-bit console game's item screen drawn at about 96 pixels wide and scaled up with hard nearest-neighbour edges: every pixel a clearly visible square block, no smooth gradients, no painterly detail, no anti-aliasing, a limited palette of about 16 bright colours with dithering for shading, the item big and centred on a dark tiled dungeon floor, a few square sparkle pixels; no interface text or numbers.

items.subject: a pair of armoured boots crackling with yellow lightning sparks
a pair of winged leather boots with motion lines behind them
a small glowing glass orb on a little bronze stand, a tiny eye reflected inside
a long silver needle pinning a glowing rune-less scroll to the ground
a small stone crypt with its lid slid open and ghostly wisps escaping into the air
